context: We conjecture that the statement of Theorem 5 remains true for any α ≥ 1/6. In other words, we state the following conjecture. ▶ Conjecture 7 (Rigidity Conjecture). Let G = ([n], E) be a graph with |E| ≳ n7/6 . Let p ∈ (R2 )n be a realization of G with the property that for every vertex v ∈ [n], the neighbors of v are not embedded into a common line. Then there exists a subgraph G′ ⊂ G with |V (G′ )| ≥ 4 such that (G′ , p|V (G′ ) ) is a rigid framework. Provided that Conjecture 7 is true, our approach would yield the first improvement of the classical upper bound, O(n4/3 ), of Spencer, Szemerédi, and Trotter [23] on the number of unit distances for more than 40 years.
